text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(The rain was cold, my legs felt heavy... 
Even so, the heat beside me burned just as 
intensely!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
(I see... So this is the Satsuki Sho! The 
fiery battle to claim the Triple Crown――!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, ahaha...! Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: (Thank you, Ace!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. claims a brilliant victory in the 
Satsuki Sho, completely unfazed by the 
heavy track!

text_block_list.name: Commentator in a Suit
text_block_list.text:
She's strong, huh. Man, she really is 
strong.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...Haa, haa, haa!! ...Grrr, dammit...!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Nwaaaaaaaagh!!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectators
text_block_list.text: ALLLRIIIGHT!!

text_block_list.name: Young Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That final stretch was insane! It 
looked like the other Umamusume were 
standing still!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Wha, whoa! She really is amazing, CB's a 
total superstar!

text_block_list.name: Middle-Aged Spectator
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, true. Mr. C.B. ran a great race!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Siiigh............ Yeah, I've got no clue.

Mr. C.B. capped off the Satsuki Sho with a 
magnificent victory.

The turf was an exceptionally heavy track, 
and by the time she passed through the 
tunnel, she was covered in mud from head 
to toe.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, there really are times when you can't 
even open your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Well, but... that was fun! That's one 
point for me, then. Fufu!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. ...I'm really looking forward 
to the next Japan Derby, too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's a grand stage where the strongest 
Classic-year girls clash to claim the top 
spot, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Maybe as much as today, or no, even more. 
I really love GⅠ races—
(Trill-ill-ill-ill...♪)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Sorry Trainer, quick phone call! My mom 
and dad are calling me!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hello? Ahaha! Both of you were watching, 
huh!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you! I won the Satsuki Sho!

In any case, next is the Japanese Derby. 
It's a battle to determine the best of her 
generation. We can't let our guard down, 
we've gotta run through to the end...!
